evals.prompt: We have evals/triage.jsonl for our Discord message classifier, but the labels in it were generated by running the classifier itself and eyeballing the outputs -- nobody manually labeled them independently. Is that eval actually telling us anything?
evals.expected_output: Correctly identifies that ground truth chosen by the system under test measures only self-consistency, not accuracy, citing the 'two domain experts would agree' / ground-truth-authority principle. Recommends re-labeling from a source closer to the product/users (a human operator) and explains why a high pass rate on this eval is not meaningful evidence of classifier quality.
